title: Muscovite army defeats the Golden Horde at Kulikovo
summary: Grand Prince Dmitry of Moscow led a coalition of Russian principalities to victory over the Tatar army of Mamai near the Don river.
reason: Moscow had grown strong enough to refuse tribute to the Golden Horde, and Mamai marched north to restore his authority.
significance: It was the first major Russian victory over the Horde and boosted Moscow as the leader of the Russian lands.
